# Complex Table

| Feature | Support | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| Headings | Full | h1-h6 supported |
| Paragraphs | Full | Standard markdown |
| Lists | Full | Ordered and unordered |
| Tables | Full | With alignment |
| Code | Full | Syntax highlighting |
| Diagrams | Partial | Mermaid only |
| Math | Partial | LaTeX only |
